claims.statement: The second deposit of $500 a side for the Tom Allen and McCoole match was not paid to Mr. Murray on July 1, 1870, and Roach, Allen's representative, claimed the stakes already deposited.

claims.statement: Tom Allen had completed an eastern tour and was expected back in St. Louis on the morning of July 2, 1870.
